message:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The issue is that `f.mIndices[pvi]` is used to index into `vertex_indices` at `v_offset + f.mIndices[pvi]`. If `f.mIndices[pvi]` is >= `m->mNumVertices`, this causes an out-of-bounds read.

The fuzzer uses `aiProcess_ValidateDataStructure` which should validate face indices. But let me check if there's a way to bypass this validation. Let me look at what the validation does:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -rn "ValidateDataStructure\|ValidateDS\|ValidateData" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/code/PostProcessing/ValidateDataStructure.cpp 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo "---" && grep -n "mNumIndices\|mIndices" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/code/PostProcessing/ValidateDataStructure.cpp | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
